ai_preview.text:
**Sport Recife's home form is suddenly sharp — Ponte Preta can't buy a win.** This is a classic David vs. Goliath moment in Serie B, except Sport just demolished América Mineiro 3-0 at the Ilha do Retiro while Ponte are limping through a four-match losing streak. 🔴

Sport have won 10 of the last 24 head-to-heads and sit in way better shape right now. Ponte's leaky defense has conceded six goals in their last three games alone — they're vulnerable, and the Recife crowd will smell blood.

Key storylines:

- **Sport's home fortress** — unbeaten in their last outing at Ilha do Retiro, now facing a defense in freefall
- **Ponte desperately need shape and discipline** — Elvis and Brandão have to create chances on the counter or this becomes a long night
- **Perotti and Marlon's attacking thrust** — Sport's midfield can press high against a leaderless Ponte setup

Expected lineups:

- **Sport Recife**: T. Couto, Felipinho, M. Ajul, K. Almeida, Claudinho, Zé Gabriel, W. Oliveira, Diego Hernández, Marlon, C. Barletta, Perotti
- **Ponte Preta**: V. F. Andreoli, Kevyson, L. Cunha, M. Silva, S. Palacios, André, Léo Gomes, R. de Souza, Elvis, Brandão, Baianinho

Prediction:

**Sport Recife 2–0 Ponte Preta.** Recife's form, home advantage, and Ponte's collapse make this a clear lean. 💪

ai_preview.text:
**Beşiktaş rolls into this one riding a three-win streak and looking to keep the good vibes rolling at home.** Erzurumspor's been wobbling lately — a shellacking from Galatasaray last time out — so the Eagles should have plenty of space to work with. 🦅

Beşiktaş has dominated the head-to-head (3 wins in the last four meetings), and their attack's been purring with 6 goals against Çorum just two games back. Erzurumspor will battle, but they're missing **E. Owusu** and haven't shown enough bite on the road to trouble a side in this form.

Key storylines:

- **D. Vlahović** and the Beşiktaş attack motor need to keep humming — Erzurumspor's defense looked fragile in that Galatasaray loss
- Midfield balance: **O. Kökçü** orchestrating for Beşiktaş vs. **B. Baiye** and **M. Yumlu** trying to shield Erzurumspor's shaky backline
- Home comfort for the Eagles, who've won three straight and haven't looked back

Expected lineups:

- **Beşiktaş JK**: A. Nübel, J. Olaitan, E. Agbadou, E. Topçu, A. Murillo, V. Černý, I. Fakili, O. Kökçü, S. Özcan, T. Bulut, D. Vlahović
- **Erzurumspor FK**: E. Taşkıran, G. Giorbelidze, A. Gerxhaliu, N. Mujakić, O. Ovacıklı, B. Baiye, M. Yumlu, M. Rodríguez, M. Fettahoglu, N. Akhundzade, E. Tozlu

Prediction:

**Beşiktaş 3–1 Erzurumspor.** Eagles have all the momentum and the head-to-head edge; this one shouldn't be close.

ai_preview.text:
**Cienciano's home fortress meets Montevideo City's momentum machine** — this Copa Sudamericana clash has all the hallmarks of a classic high-altitude battle. 🏔️

Cienciano are riding massive swings: a 6-1 demolition of Botafogo at home followed by a shutout loss on the road. Montevideo City, meanwhile, are purring — three wins in their last five, including back-to-back victories over Tigre. The Uruguayans know how to travel and grind.

Key storylines:

- **Cienciano's home dominance vs. City's defensive resolve** — the hosts have obliterated teams at Estadio Inca Garcilaso, but Montevideo City haven't folded easily on the road
- **A. Hohberg and C. Garcés leading the charge** — Cienciano's attacking pair will need to impose themselves early before City's D settles in
- **K. Silva orchestrating from midfield** — Montevideo City's engine room will be crucial in strangling Cienciano's space and tempo

Expected lineups:

- **Cienciano**: Í. Espinoza, M. Martinich, K. Becerra, M. Amondarain, C. Cabello, G. Barreto, A. Robles, C. Souza, A. Hohberg, J. Romagnoli, C. Garcés
- **Montevideo City Torque**: F. Torgnascioli, F. Silvera, G. Kagelmacher, E. Agüero, F. Pizzichillo, K. Silva, G. Montes, P. Siles, R. Lecchini, S. Rodríguez, E. Obregón

Prediction:

**Cienciano 2-1 Montevideo City Torque**. The altitude and home roar edge the hosts, but City will make them work for it. 📍
